name: Hard Times
source:
Hard Times tells the story of a young man who leaves his house and ended up in a new town, trying to forget his past. Once there, due to unexpected circumstances, he ends up working for the Guerra crime family, one of the major organizations in said town. Perhaps this is a chance to bring change to his life?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Kuranai]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《Hard Times》讲述一名年轻男子，离家前往陌生城镇，试图遗忘过去的故事。来到这里后，意想不到的状况，让他开始为格拉犯罪家族工作。那是镇上势力最大的组织之一。或许，这正是改变人生的机会？

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/Kuranai]Patreon[/url]]
